LanguageData.BO_GizmoDesc: Open the recipe window of this bench: grouped recipes, search, what the stock allows, and the bill queue.
LanguageData.BO_SetEnabledTip: Off: the vanilla "Add bill" menu everywhere and no workbench button.
LanguageData.BO_SetIntegration: The "Add bill" button of the bill tab:
LanguageData.BO_SetIntAutoTip: Only works while no other mod replaces the whole bill tab (Nice Bill Tab does, while its tab replacement is on).
LanguageData.BO_SetIntGizmo: Keep the original menu (this window opens only from the workbench button)
LanguageData.BO_SetIntGizmoTip: Use this to keep whatever menu another mod gives you and still have the catalog.
LanguageData.BO_SetGizmoNice: Only while Nice Bill Tab has replaced the bill tab
LanguageData.BO_SetMin: Use this window from {0} recipes on
LanguageData.BO_SetKeepOpen: Keep the window open after adding a bill
LanguageData.BO_SetKeepOpenTip: Hold Shift while clicking to do this once.
LanguageData.BO_SetNiceOn: Nice Bill Tab is replacing the bill tab, so its "Add bill" is used. Open this window with the workbench button "Recipes".
LanguageData.BO_SetNiceOff: Nice Bill Tab is active but its tab replacement is off: "Add bill" opens this window.
LanguageData.BO_NoRecipes: This workbench has no recipe available right now.
LanguageData.BO_Hint: Double click or +: add. Shift+click: compare.
LanguageData.BO_FilterStockTip: Hide recipes the map does not have the materials for.
LanguageData.BO_SortAvailTip: Recipes you can make now come first.
LanguageData.BO_StockUnknown: Stock unknown (an ingredient is not a counted resource)
LanguageData.BO_AddTip: Add bill (Shift keeps the window open)
LanguageData.BO_PickOne: Select a recipe to see its details, or pin several to compare them.
LanguageData.BO_NoSkill: No colonist has the required skill.
LanguageData.BO_BestOnBench: Best of this kind on this bench: {0}
LanguageData.BO_BestInStockHint: Highlighted: the best material you have enough of.
LanguageData.BO_SingleMaterial: One material is used for the whole item (no mixing).
LanguageData.BO_NoCommonStats: These recipes share no stats to compare.
LanguageData.BO_StatTip_dps: Damage per second (aiming time, cooldown and burst included).
LanguageData.BO_StatTip_damage: Damage of one hit or shot.
LanguageData.BO_StatTip_users: How many weapons can load this ammunition (Combat Extended).
LanguageData.BO_StatTip_sharp: Armor against sharp damage. With several materials it is the best one; the detail shows the range.
LanguageData.BO_StatTip_work: Work amount for one run of the recipe (the number on the info card). Faster colonists finish sooner.
LanguageData.BO_StatTip_skill: Highest minimum skill level the recipe asks for. Red: no colonist on the map has it.
LanguageData.BO_StatTip_value: Market value of one item of the product (default material).
LanguageData.BO_StatTip_make: How many batches of this recipe the stored resources allow (same counts as the resource list on the left).
LanguageData.BO_CanMakeUnknown: Unknown: none of the ingredients is a counted resource.
LanguageData.BO_PinPanelTip: Pinned resources. Click to collapse. Ctrl+click a resource in the list on the left to pin or unpin it; right-click a row for the minimum.
LanguageData.BO_PinUsedBy: Recipes that use it (batches the stock allows):
LanguageData.BO_SetPinPanel: Pinned resources panel (Ctrl+click in the resource list)
LanguageData.BO_SetPinPanelTip: Shows the pinned resources next to the resource list on the left, with stock, minimum alert and the recipes that use each one.
LanguageData.BO_MaxTip: Everything the stock allows: {0} batches ({1} items).
LanguageData.BO_SearchHelp: Several words must all match. Plain words search the name, mod, material, category, layer, tag and research. Prefixes: @ category (@ammo), % layer or body part (%head), # mod (#royalty), + bonus or effect (+bandwidth, +psychic). Ctrl+F focuses the search.
LanguageData.BO_QueueTabTip: Show the bills already queued on this bench: drag to reorder, pause, copy, templates.
LanguageData.BO_SetIngIcons: Ingredient icons under each recipe name
LanguageData.BO_SetAutoName: Name the bill after the picked material
LanguageData.BO_SetAutoNameTip: Only when a material is picked in the detail panel: the bill is named "Recipe (Material)".
LanguageData.BO_SetStepByBatch: "Until X" steps by what one craft makes (all bills)
LanguageData.BO_SetStepByBatchTip: The -/+ of "Until X" adds or removes what one craft makes (5 for "mortar shells x5", 200 for "cartridge x200"), also in the vanilla bill list and in other mods. Some mods set a fixed step (Combat Extended uses 20 for every ammo). Off: the original steps come back.
LanguageData.BO_SetGlobalButton: "Bills" button on the bottom bar (all benches, queues, templates)
LanguageData.BO_SetGlobalButtonTip: Applies when you close this window.
LanguageData.BO_ModeDefaultTip: Like the vanilla menu: do once.
LanguageData.BO_ModeCountTip: Make the amount you set, then stop.
LanguageData.BO_ModeTargetTip: Keep making it until you have X in stock.
LanguageData.BO_ModeForeverTip: Keeps making it while there are materials.
LanguageData.BO_TimesTip: How many copies of this bill to add at once (up to the free space of the bill list).
LanguageData.BO_MaterialTip: Restrict the bill to one material. The number in the menu is the stock.
LanguageData.BO_MatSortTip: Order the materials by this stat.
LanguageData.BO_IngClickTip: Click: info, find on the map, queue it on another bench.
LanguageData.BO_DiffOnlyTip: Hide the stats where all pinned recipes are equal.
LanguageData.BO_QPasteTip: Paste what was copied last: the whole queue (Copy queue) or one bill (copy button of a card, or of the vanilla bill tab). What does not fit this bench is skipped.
LanguageData.BO_QCopyQueueTip: Copy every bill of this queue. Paste puts them all on any bench of this game (what does not fit is skipped). To keep a queue across saves, use Save template.
LanguageData.BO_QQueueCopied: Queue copied ({0} bills). Use Paste on any bench.
LanguageData.BO_QSaveTplTip: Save this whole queue under a name, to paste on this or another bench, in any save.
LanguageData.BO_QTemplatesTip: Paste a saved queue here (what does not fit this bench is skipped), or manage the templates.
LanguageData.BO_QActionsTip: Paste, templates, pause all, clear done / all.
LanguageData.BO_QDetails: Details: filters, quality, hit points, radius, worker.
LanguageData.BO_QModeTip: Click to switch: Do X times / Until X / Forever. Use - and + for the number.
LanguageData.BO_MatClickTip: Click to change the material of this bill.
LanguageData.BO_QMoveUp: Move up (Shift: to the top). You can also drag the card.
LanguageData.BO_QMoveDown: Move down (Shift: to the bottom). You can also drag the card.
LanguageData.BO_QCopied: Copied. Use Paste on any bench.
LanguageData.BO_TplBusy: Templates are not available while the game loads or saves.
LanguageData.BO_TplWriteFail: Could not write the template file (see the log).
LanguageData.BO_TplNone: No template saved yet. Open the queue of a bench and use "Save template".
LanguageData.BO_PickBench: Pick a bench on the left.
LanguageData.BO_PinnedTip: Pinned for comparing (see Compare in the detail panel).
LanguageData.BO_SetCompactTab: Compact bill tab: recipe list and details
LanguageData.BO_SetCompactTabTip: A wider bill tab: queue and recipe list on the left, recipe details on the right. Off while Nice Bill Tab replaces the tab. Reopen the tab to apply.
LanguageData.BO_SetTabQueue: Height of the bill queue in the tab: {0}
LanguageData.BO_QPauseAllTip: Pauses every bill of this bench (or resumes them all when all are paused).
LanguageData.BO_QClearDoneTip: Deletes the "do X times" bills that already reached zero.
LanguageData.BO_QClearAllTip: Deletes every bill of this bench (asks first).
LanguageData.BO_QClearAllConfirm: Delete all {0} bills of this bench?
LanguageData.BO_TplOverwrite: A template named "{0}" already exists for this bench. Replace it?
LanguageData.BO_LinkDesc: Share the bill queue with another bench of the same type: adding, removing, reordering, pausing or editing a bill on one shows on the other, and "do X times" is counted together. This bench's queue is copied to the one you pick.
LanguageData.BO_UnlinkDesc: Stop sharing the queue. Each bench keeps its own copy of the bills.
LanguageData.BO_LinkRejectDef: Only benches of the same type can be linked.
LanguageData.BO_LinkRejectMap: The benches must be on the same map.
LanguageData.BO_LinkRejectGroups: Both benches are in different link groups. Unlink one of them first.
LanguageData.BO_LinkConfirm: Link benches? The bills already on the other bench ({0}) are replaced by a copy of this queue. Unlinking later keeps the copy.
LanguageData.BO_LinkDone: Benches linked ({0}). They now share the same bills.
LanguageData.BO_SetLinkTip: Adds a "Link bench" button to workbenches. Turning it off keeps existing links but stops syncing.
LanguageData.BO_ResSortTip: Sort the resource list: by category (folding sections), by amount or by name.
LanguageData.BO_SetResList: Organized resource list on the left (names, sort, categories, search)
LanguageData.BO_SetResListTip: Replaces the icon-and-number resource list with one that shows names, sorts, folds categories and has a search box. Ctrl+click pins a resource to the top. Off = vanilla list.
LanguageData.BO_BenchPrioTip: Bench priority (-5 to +5). Colonists try the higher one first among benches of the same skill, then the closest. Shift: 5 at a time.
LanguageData.BO_SetBenchPrio: Bench priority across bench types of the same skill
LanguageData.BO_SetBenchPrioTip: On: priority also orders different bench types of the same skill (fabrication bench before smithy). Off: it only orders benches of the same type. The Work tab still decides between skills.
LanguageData.BO_QDoneTip: Finished. Use Clear finished, or raise the number to run it again.
LanguageData.BO_QMetTip: Target reached. It runs again when the stock drops below {0}.
LanguageData.BO_QNotNowTip: Nobody can work on it right now (materials, skill, work area or bench).
LanguageData.BO_TabHintTip: Click: details. Double click or +: add the bill. Right click: open the full window on that recipe. Shift+click: pin to compare.
LanguageData.BO_KeysHelp: Keys: arrows select, Enter adds, Shift+Enter or Shift on + keeps the window open, Ctrl+F searches.
LanguageData.BO_AmmoFilterTip: Show only this type of round (click again to clear).
LanguageData.BO_MaxTipTarget: Target = what you have ({0}) + what the stock allows ({1}).
LanguageData.BO_SetMinTip: Benches with fewer recipes keep the original "Add bill" menu. 0 = always use this window.
LanguageData.BO_ColBillsTip: Bills on the bench: running / total (paused ones do not count as running).
LanguageData.BO_TplWindowHint: To paste one, open the queue of a bench: Actions, Templates.
LanguageData.BO_PresetTip: Set {0} (the button stays marked). Click it again to add {0} more.
LanguageData.BO_DevDumpGroups: Dev mode: write the group of every recipe of this bench to the log (Player.log).
LanguageData.BO_DevDumpDone: Recipe groups written to the log.
LanguageData.BO_CanMakeStuffTip: Counting only {0} (you have {1}): the bill will use no other material.
LanguageData.BO_MatRowClickTip: Click: make the bill with this material (click again: any material).
LanguageData.BO_BonusPartEffTip: How well the installed part works compared to a natural one (100%).
LanguageData.BO_BonusColTip: {0} gained when the item is worn or equipped.
LanguageData.BO_BonusMarkTip: This item does more than its stats show:
LanguageData.BO_QPasteQueueTip: Paste the copied queue: {0} of {1} bills fit this bench.
LanguageData.BO_RecipeUnavailable: {0}: this recipe is not available on this bench right now (research not done, or removed by a mod).
LanguageData.BO_SetSlBabiesTip: Adds a "Babies" column to the vanilla auto slaughter window. A baby gives about 20% of an adult's meat (10% for tiny babies), so babies are not auto-slaughtered and do not count toward the limits unless you tick "Allow slaughter" for that animal. Off: vanilla rules.
LanguageData.BO_SlBabiesTip: Babies are animals in their first life stage. A baby gives about 20% of an adult's meat (10% for tiny babies). Juveniles give about 50%.
LanguageData.BO_SlCurrentTip: Current babies of this animal that auto slaughter can see.
LanguageData.BO_SlAllowTip: Allow auto slaughter of babies of this animal. Off: babies are never auto-slaughtered and are left out of the young and total counts and limits (like bonded animals when they are not allowed).
LanguageData.BO_SetTaskForce: "Task force" button on the Work tab
LanguageData.BO_SetTaskForceTip: Temporary work priority: put many colonists on a work type (e.g. Handling at 1) for a few hours and give each one back the priority they had when the time is over.
LanguageData.BO_TFButtonTip: Raise one or more work types on many colonists for a while (e.g. everyone on Handling for 6 hours after animals escaped a pen). When the time is over, each colonist goes back to the priority they had. A priority you change by hand in the meantime is kept.
LanguageData.BO_TFIntro: Temporary priority: when the time is over, each colonist goes back to the value they had (a value you change by hand in the meantime is kept).
LanguageData.BO_TFPrioTip: Priority set during the task force (1 = done first). Within the same number the game follows the column order of the Work tab: Firefighter, Patient, Doctor, Basic and Warden come before Handling.
LanguageData.BO_TFInterruptTip: Colonists doing ordinary work of a lower priority drop it and pick the task force work right away. Never interrupted: eating, sleeping, doctor work (rescue, tending, surgery), patients in bed, firefighting, emergencies, colonists carrying someone, drafted colonists and orders you gave by hand.
LanguageData.BO_TFManualOff: Manual priorities are off: without them the task force can only turn the work on (no priority 1).
LanguageData.BO_TFTurnOnManualTip: The same as the "Manual priorities" checkbox of the Work tab. It stays on after the task force.
LanguageData.BO_TFPickWork: Pick at least one work type on the left.
LanguageData.BO_TFIncapable: {0} cannot do any of the chosen work types.
LanguageData.BO_TFEndTip: End the task force ({0}) now: each colonist goes back to the priority they had.
LanguageData.BO_TFRemoveTip: Take {0} out of this task force (back to the previous priority).
LanguageData.BO_TFNeedPawn: No colonist selected can do the chosen work.
LanguageData.BO_TFNothing: Nothing to change: no selected colonist can do the chosen work.
LanguageData.BO_TFEnded: Task force over ({0}): {1} colonists back to their previous priority.
LanguageData.BO_TFEndedEarly: Task force ended ({0}): {1} colonists back to their previous priority.
LanguageData.BO_TFKept: {0} kept a priority you changed by hand.
